claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on April 6, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. PT.
SpaceX's Falcon 9 launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base on April 6, 2026 was highly visible across Southern California.
The first-stage booster of SpaceX's Falcon 9 launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base on April 6, 2026 landed on a drone ship.
SpaceX's Falcon 9 launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base on April 6, 2026 created a visible "twilight phenomenon" plume in the sky.
The Starlink 17-21 mission is scheduled from Vandenberg Space Force Base on April 9, 2026.
The Starlink 17-21 mission has a launch window opening around 7:39 p.m. PT.
A 49-second Spaceflight Now YouTube video uploaded on April 5, 2026 shows a previous SpaceX Falcon 9 launch from California
